QUOTE: "the wrapper `LlamaCppBackend::tokenize` (`llama_cpp_backend.cpp:788-800`) passes the empty vector through, or returns empty when no tokenizer is wired."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the backend wrapper returns an empty vector both on tokenizer failure (pass-through) and when no tokenizer is wired, so the two cases give the same value.
